description: Find text in a PDF: search a born-digital PDF (one made by software: invoices, statements, reports, contracts, forms) for a word, phrase or regular expression and get each hit with its page and box in PDF points, measured from the bottom-left of the page as the viewer sees it with y on the text baseline (the same frame pdf_edit uses, so a hit's x, y, width and height give the position for a stamp). Case-insensitive unless case_sensitive is true. A match never spans lines. Scanned PDFs have no text layer: their pages are listed in pages_without_text (no OCR). A long search continues across calls through next_page (see the pages argument). Read-only: the source is never modified.

max_hits.description: Stop once more hits than this exist. Default 100. If truncated is true but next_page is null, hits on a page listed in pages_skipped beyond max_hits can be retrieved only by raising max_hits or narrowing the query.

pages.description: Pages to search, 1-based: "1-3,5,8-". Default: all pages. At most 200 pages per call. While next_page in the result is not null, calling again with pages set to next_page followed by a dash (for example 4-) continues with no gaps or repeated hits.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

query.description: Text to find, or a pattern when regex is true. At most 200 characters.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression from a safe subset: literals, classes, dot, anchors, word boundaries, groups, alternation and quantifiers including lazy ones. Backreferences, lookahead, lookbehind, named groups, property escapes and inline flags are rejected. Default false.

whole_word.description: Only report matches with no letter, digit, underscore or combining mark directly before or after. Default false.

name: pdf_find_text

height.description: Font size; the box spans y to y + height

line.description: The line the match is on

line_truncated.description: Present only when line was cut

text.description: The matched text as it appears on the page

next_page.description: First page not fully searched, or null when finished

truncated.description: The scan stopped before every selected page was searched; continue from next_page while it is not null; null with truncated means hits beyond max_hits on a page in pages_skipped were dropped

title: Find text in a PDF
